propositions: When the config key llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir is set to a non-empty path, the final structured-parse failure in _pai_structured's prompted reask loop writes a timestamped artifact containing the raw reply, model id, contract name, and attempt count before raising the error.
When llm.parse_failure_artifact_dir is unset (default None), the failure path is byte-for-byte unchanged and no artifact is written.
The new config field is added to LLMConfig in src/rebar/llm/config.py and resolved via _llm_str with precedence CLI > env (REBAR_LLM_PARSE_FAILURE_ARTIFACT_DIR) > file > default None.
Artifact writes are best-effort and never mask the original parse error; unwritable directories and I/O failures are swallowed and the parse failure is raised unchanged.
Old artifacts are pruned by mtime after each write, keeping at most 20 per directory to prevent unbounded growth.
